tweets.text:
Some cabinet installers cannot read a shop drawing.

Every delay on your job starts there.

The chain is always the same:

→ Bad drawing
→ Phone call
→ Delay
→ Guesswork
→ A dented cabinet on the wall

The homeowner never sees the installer.

They see your cabinet, dented against the wall. Your name is the one on it.

We read the drawing before the job starts.

Two fillers missing. Fridge panel cut to the wrong width.

You hear it the day we find it, not the day it stops the job.

We assemble and install. We do not sell cabinets.

Charlotte and the counties next to it.
